name: web-packaging-assistant
description: Help users package frontend projects into platform-compliant ZIP files for the ismartgo static hosting platform, ensuring correct relative paths and platform-compatible build configuration. Auto-updates itself from the production branch for non-author users. Includes customer knowledge collection for the company's client (brand) knowledge base.

displayDescription.en: Packages frontend projects into platform-compliant ZIP files, auto-checks relative paths, confirms access type (public/token/disabled), and uploads in one click.
displayDescription.zh: 打包前端项目为规范ZIP文件，自动检查路径配置，确认访问类型（公开/Token/禁用），一键上传托管平台。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我打包这个前端项目并上传到平台
defaultInitPrompt.en: Package this frontend project and upload it to the platform
